newsitem.title: USA: Reliance sets three-for-two stock split.
newsitem.headline: Reliance sets three-for-two stock split.

text.p: Reliance Steel & Aluminum Co said Wednesday it declared a three-for-two stock split in the form of a 50 percent stock dividend.
The common stock split will be effected on June 27 with new stock certificates issued to shareholders of record June 6, the company said.
Shareholders of record will be entitled to one additional share of common stock for every two shares of the company's common stock held on that date, the company said.

Reliance said its regular quarterly cash dividend will remain at the current rate of 3-1/2 cents per share of common stock, resulting in a 50 percent increase in the cash dividend beginning with the 1997 third quarter dividend payment.
The stock split will increase Reliance's total common shares outstanding from about 10.1 million to 15.2 million, the company said.
